_doc: OPEN-STANDARDS-1 (Rowan, 2026-11-25): use established open standards, never a home-grown format, and wire each into a closed loop. Checked by `python3 -m foundation openstd --check` (in checks); tests tests/foundation/test_openstd.py. A new format class is added here with its standard before it appears; a new file in a covered scope must meet the standard at once; the baseline in doctrine/open-standards-baseline.json only shrinks.

formats.standard: JSON Schema 2020-12 ($schema on every config file)
formats.next: drain the baseline: add $schema and a per-file schema to each listed config
formats.trigger: every checks run (baseline may only shrink)

formats.standard: CloudEvents 1.0 JSON format, one event per line
formats.next: ops/openstd/events.jsonl emits CloudEvents now; convert each baseline ledger family (Q-STD-ledgers)
formats.trigger: every checks run (new ledgers must conform at once)

formats.standard: Cloudflare Wrangler configuration (TOML or JSONC), declarative infrastructure as code
Declarative desired state with a reconcile loop (Kubernetes controller pattern)
OpenAPI 3.1 with stable operationId, API catalog (RFC 9727), Link headers (RFC 8288)
AT Protocol (OAuth with PAR, PKCE, DPoP)

formats.next: emit JSON-LD (Article, Dataset, SoftwareApplication) on every content page
wrap /api/live/changes and handoff events in CloudEvents envelopes
turn on Workers OTLP export and map tick steps to spans

formats.standard: OPA Rego, or JSON Schema conditionals where a rule is a data shape
formats.next: express autonomy/policy.json gates as schema conditionals first, Rego only for cross-file rules

formats.standard: SemVer 2.0, Conventional Commits 1.0, Keep a Changelog 1.1

formats.covers: build provenance and bill of materials
formats.standard: SLSA provenance via GitHub attestations (Sigstore, in-toto), SBOM in SPDX or CycloneDX, OpenSSF Scorecard
formats.next: attest deploy artifacts, publish SBOM, run Scorecard weekly

formats.standard: W3C PROV-O (JSON-LD) and RO-Crate for research packages
formats.next: map the provenance ledger fields to prov:Activity, prov:Entity, prov:Agent
